# TPC-DS Q55 — Brand Manager Sales

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds
```

> [TPC-DS](../../tpc-ds.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS queries](index.md)

Reports brand sales for items managed by a specific manager

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim, store_sales, item WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 36 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_year = 2001 GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id ORDER BY ext_price DESC, i_brand_id LIMIT 100
```
